summary: Part 8 is not approved, and this is not a chapter or publication approval. I read all ten owned units (s0082-s0091); they contain no births, deaths or ages. I checked the dates against ZZTJ 卷096. Han's flight (338), his stay (338-340) and his 340 return are supported. The raid's 340-341 window is supported, and ZZTJ's 340 falls inside it. The 於是 block of Longcheng building and Guo Xi's investiture is supported at 341, because Jinshu's order and ZZTJ 咸康七年 agree. Defects: claim-639 and hints-p115 extend Wang Che's mission to 341, after Han's 340 return. The grantor in claim-734 is unresolved, since ZZTJ places the enfeoffment inside the Jin court's grant.

itemChecks.event: Murong Huang's undated campaign against the Shi and the Wang Che mission.
itemChecks.reason: Undated in Jinshu; it sits after Yu Liang's death (340) and before the 於是/咸康七年 block, so 340-341 expresses uncertainty. ZZTJ dates the mission and raid to 咸康六年 (340), which is inside the window.

itemChecks.event: Murong Huang raided You and Ji through Yiweng Pass.
itemChecks.reason: The raid has no date in Jinshu beyond narrative order (340-341). ZZTJ dates it 咸康六年冬十月 (340), inside the window; no precise year is forced.

evidence.quote: 率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城

itemChecks.reason: Shi Jilong's attestation comes from Huang's planning speech before the raid; 340-341 matches the raid window, and ZZTJ's 340 falls inside it.

evidence.quote: 石季龍自以安樂諸城守防嚴重

itemChecks.event: Murong Han's flight to Yuwen Gui and his feigned madness.
itemChecks.reason: 初 marks a flashback to Duan Liao's defeat, which ZZTJ dates 咸康四年 (338, 翰北奔宇文氏). Han escaped in 咸康六年二月 (340), so 338-340 bounds the stay correctly.

evidence.quote: 初，段遼之敗也，建威翰奔于宇文歸

itemChecks.event: Murong Han fled to Yuwen Gui after Duan Liao's defeat.
itemChecks.reason: The flight follows Duan Liao's defeat (ZZTJ 338). It belongs to the 338-340 window, and the window is not presented as one exact year.

itemChecks.event: Murong Han feigned madness while at Yuwen Gui's court.
itemChecks.reason: The feigned madness happened during the stay, between the 338 flight and the 340 escape. ZZTJ narrates it under 咸康六年 as background, which agrees with the 338-340 window.

itemChecks.event: Murong Han stole horses and returned to Huang with his two sons.
itemChecks.reason: ZZTJ dates the escape to 咸康六年二月 (AD 340). Jinshu places it before the 340-341 raid, so the point year 340 rests on an explicit witness that agrees with Jinshu.

evidence.quote: 翰乃竊歸駿馬，攜其二子而還

itemChecks.event: Yuwen Gui hosted Murong Han and trusted his act.
itemChecks.reason: Gui's hosting ran from Han's arrival after Duan Liao's 338 defeat to Han's escape in 340, so 338-340 is supported.

itemChecks.event: Wang Che's spying mission to Murong Han.
itemChecks.reason: Wang Che's mission comes before Han's return, which this packet dates to 340 (claims 629 and 1132; ZZTJ 咸康六年二月). The window's 341 end has no support and contradicts that sequence. The mission can be no later than 340.

personChecks.reason: Han's flight in 338, his stay until 340 and his 340 return are coherent across claims 624-629 and 1132 and the hints.
Yuwen Gui's single owned event (338-340) is coherent; his later 343-344 appearances belong to p129.
Wang Che's claim-639 and its hint extend to 341, past Han's 340 return.
The investiture and Longcheng dates (341) are coherent with context items, but who granted the s0091 enfeoffment is unresolved.
The 341 Longcheng building is consistent across claims 729 and 788 and the hint.
The 341 Longcheng building is consistent across claims 730 and 789 and the hint.
The 341 investiture is consistent across claims 733 and 790 and the hint.
The 341 mission is consistent across claims 732 and 791 and the hint.

findings.problem: Wang Che's mission (s0084-s0086) came before Murong Han's return, which claims 629 and 1132 and ZZTJ 咸康六年二月 date to AD 340. Claim-639 and hints-p115 nonetheless run to 341.
findings.action: Use date-context westernYear AD 340 (or westernBounds onOrBefore AD 340) for claim-639 and set hints-p115 to ["AD 340"]. Do not extend the mission past the return.

findings.problem: Jinshu s0091 封諸功臣百餘人 has no subject. ZZTJ 咸康七年 lists 又封諸功臣百餘人 inside the Jin court's investiture grant, so Huang as grantor (claim-734) is an owner reading the sources don't establish. The 341 date itself is supported.
findings.action: Keep the 341 date. Resolve the event owner: either reframe it as a Jin court enfeoffment of Huang's officers or mark the owner uncertain, preserving the Jinshu wording.
